The Approach

Strength. Balance. Soul.

However you move with us, every class is built around the same three things.

01

Strength

Full-body workouts that build real strength, with modifications for every level built in from the start.

02

Balance

Mindful movement to improve balance both mentally and physically.

03

Soul

Relaxed, welcoming, and fun. No experience needed, no intimidating atmosphere, just feel-good exercise.

About Hannah

Introducing Hannah

After years of living with back pain, things came to a head when Hannah was training for the London Marathon, her back completely gave up. That's when she found Pilates, and it changed everything. What started as a way to feel better quickly became a passion, and now, more than 10 years on, Hannah loves helping others discover the power of Pilates too.

Mum of two (or three, if you count her very needy Vizsla), lover of all things outdoors, beautiful views and the shimmer of sun on water. She truly believes Pilates keeps you doing what you love, whatever that looks like for you.

That's why Hannah set up Meraki Pilates in Wotton-under-Edge.

What to expect
  • Relaxed, welcoming classes for every ability
  • Small groups on the reformer, max 4 people
  • No experience or equipment needed
  • A local and supportive community
